decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out accessories like cases, mounting shelves, and charging cables to focus on the actual speakers. My consideration set focuses on highly-rated, portable, and waterproof models. The JBL Go 3, INSMY, and JBL Clip 3 stood out for their exceptional average ratings and large review counts. The comiso and XENEO speakers were included for offering higher wattage and additional features like FM radio. I ultimately selected the JBL Go 3 as the final choice because of its high 4.7 rating and the strong reputation of JBL Pro Sound in a very compact, affordable, and durable IP67-rated form factor.
